title: SPECIAL PERMIT TO MODIFY USE OR BULK REGULATIONS

blocks.html: For any zoning lot within the Special Forest Hills District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of the use or bulk regulations, other than floor area ratio provisions, provided the Commission shall find that such:
blocks.plainText: For any zoning lot within the Special Forest Hills District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of the use or bulk regulations, other than floor area ratio provisions, provided the Commission shall find that such:

blocks.html: (a)        use or bulk modification will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;
blocks.plainText: (a) use or bulk modification will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;

blocks.html: (b)        use modification will encourage a lively pedestrian environment along Austin Street;
blocks.plainText: (b) use modification will encourage a lively pedestrian environment along Austin Street;

blocks.html: (c)        modification is the only practicable way to achieve the programmatic requirements of the development;
blocks.plainText: (c) modification is the only practicable way to achieve the programmatic requirements of the development;

blocks.html: (d)        modification will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;
blocks.plainText: (d) modification will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;

blocks.html: (e)        modification of bulk will permit adequate access of light and air to surrounding streets and properties; and
blocks.plainText: (e) modification of bulk will permit adequate access of light and air to surrounding streets and properties; and

blocks.html: (f)        use or bulk modification will relate harmoniously to the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: (f) use or bulk modification will relate harmoniously to the character of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
